prospective_scope: separate extension proposed after partial v1 observation; no v1/native times imported

degree_policy.center: unchanged unweighted coordinatewise median with implicit zeros

recursive_policy.scope: unchanged recursive composition of named cheap criteria; no native code

evaluator: one Python-integer sparse exact modularity cache implementation on every arm and gamma

incumbent_policy.fallback: external original discovery allowed even when quotient-unrepresentable

schedule.case_order: dataset then discovery seed then gamma
schedule.downstream: left rotate by (j+r) mod 4 then reverse if floor(j/4) is odd
schedule.prefix_finalization_order: U,D,R,RD then 1,3,9 after all nine seeds

retention_policy: all four arm states and all raw label vectors retained through case finalization

memory_policy.whole_case: monotone process ru_maxrss including retained objects

phase_policy.candidate_call_partition: source B-F common discovery and source F fixed-bank refinement, preserving both diagnostics
phase_policy.additional_discovery_validation: separate measured common_discovery intervals for original discovery-label validation/materialization
phase_policy.additional_bank_validation: separate measured fixed_bank_refinement intervals for bank-only identity/provenance validation; never charged to U
phase_policy.final_fixed_bank_refinement_seconds: source F plus disjoint additional bank-only validation seconds
phase_policy.final_common_discovery_seconds: source B-F plus disjoint additional discovery-label validation seconds
phase_policy.nested_source_times: diagnostics only; never added to outer phases
phase_policy.standalone_total: common C + F only for D/R/RD + own arm H + first k seed phases + only that prefix finalization
phase_policy.shared_setup: physical reuse across gamma; once charged to each standalone single-resolution workload
excluded: raw loading and archive JSON decoding

prerequisites.source_selection: fixed completed parent plus whole recovery Davis plus all originally unlaunched scaling; original parent failure retained

unexpected_failure_policy: retain raw partial records and halt this source version; no overwrite or favorable repeat selection
